ext.text: Human exploration beyond Earth brings extraordinary challenges. During long-duration space missions, understanding changes in astronaut health becomes essential.
ext.spoken: Human exploration beyond Earth brings extraordinary challenges. During long-duration space missions, understanding changes in astronaut health becomes essential.

ext.text: Spaceflight can affect cardiovascular function, bone and muscle health, sleep, behavior, and the body's response to its environment. Astronauts need clear information to monitor these changes.
ext.spoken: Spaceflight can affect cardiovascular function, bone and muscle health, sleep, behavior, and the body's response to its environment. Astronauts need clear information to monitor these changes.

ext.text: ASTRA VITAL is an offline-first astronaut health monitoring prototype developed by NYXARA NOVA for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
ext.spoken: Astra Vital is an offline-first astronaut health monitoring prototype developed by Nixara Nova for the NASA Space Apps Challenge twenty twenty-six.

ext.text: The Mission Dashboard brings health records, recent measurements, alerts, and trends into one clear operational view.
ext.spoken: The Mission Dashboard brings health records, recent measurements, alerts, and trends into one clear operational view.

ext.text: Crew members can record physiological and behavioral indicators, explore related body systems, and review their personal health history.
ext.spoken: Crew members can record physiological and behavioral indicators, explore related body systems, and review their personal health history.

ext.text: Its transparent, rule-based engine identifies unusual changes and explains why an alert appears, what it means, and when medical attention should be considered.
ext.spoken: Its transparent, rule-based engine identifies unusual changes and explains why an alert appears, what it means, and when medical attention should be considered.

ext.text: ASTRA VITAL connects health indicators with NASA's five human spaceflight hazards: space radiation, isolation, distance from Earth, gravity fields, and hostile environments.
ext.spoken: Astra Vital connects health indicators with NASA's five human spaceflight hazards: space radiation, isolation, distance from Earth, gravity fields, and hostile environments.

ext.text: Designed for intermittent connectivity, it stores records locally and queues synchronization when a connection becomes available.
ext.spoken: Designed for intermittent connectivity, it stores records locally and queues synchronization when a connection becomes available.

ext.text: The prototype also explores real laboratory datasets from NASA's Inspiration4 research, while keeping demonstration vital signs clearly labeled as synthetic.
